clips.send: A chronic-fatigue sufferer sends this to their own doctor: proof a normal blood test doesn't mean nothing's wrong - the anger of being told 'you're fine' for years.
clips.caption:
Dr. Daniel Pompa told Kevin Trudeau about the stretch where he kept getting sicker with no answer: headaches, gut problems, sound sensitivity, insomnia, panic attacks.

He found a condition called Mad Hatter's disease online and matched every symptom on the list - the one people got from mercury exposure, long before anyone understood why.

So he ran a blood test for mercury. It came back clean. The doctor's exact words: 'You're healthier than me, son.'

Years later a different test - looking at his tissue, not his blood - found what the first test missed completely.

Ever been told your labs are normal while you still feel terrible?

clips.send: A chronic-fatigue sufferer sends this to the friend who just got 'normal' bloodwork back - the anxiety that the real test was never run.
clips.caption:
Dr. Daniel Pompa's blood test for mercury came back normal. A different doctor told him why: a blood test only shows acute exposure - if it's chronic, the mercury is sitting in your tissue instead, invisible to that test.

A new test found very high levels of several heavy metals. The source: two silver fillings, 50% mercury, removed from his own mouth - mercury that had been sitting two inches from his pituitary gland.

That single discovery sent him on the path he still teaches today: how the body actually clears heavy metals once you know where to look.

Has your own bloodwork ever come back 'normal' while you still felt wrong?

clips.send: Someone trying intermittent fasting sends this to their gym-buddy group chat: the protein rule nobody mentions, before they waste a fast.
clips.caption:
Dr. Daniel Pompa told Kevin Trudeau that 'fasting' isn't one thing - it's four different things.

Daily intermittent (an eating window, skipping a meal), pure water only, a partial fast (500-1,200 calories, under 20 grams of protein), and a full dry fast with no food or water at all.

His warning: too much protein during a partial fast, and your body never switches into autophagy - the process that clears out old, damaged cells.

Which of these four have you actually tried?

#kevintrudeau #fasting #autophagy #healthtruth #wbdaily #cellularhealth
